## Description

Aggregated adoption and usage by practice, staff and patients with no patient data; any count under 5 is hidden. Health score from usage, payments, support tickets and errors, with a reason and a next step. Reports (metrics, daily/weekly/monthly, PDF or CSV) sent to named people only. Reuses the PHI-free reporting store decided in MDV-P4-029.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a count is 4, when the chart renders, then it shows as hidden.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a report, when is scheduled, then only the named recipients get it and it holds no patient data.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a practice's health score falls, when it is shown, then the reasons are listed.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
